limber.name: limber
limber.descriptionEs: Evita ser paralizado gracias a la flexibilidad de su cuerpo.
limber.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.

cloud-nine.name: cloud-nine
cloud-nine.descriptionEs: Anula todos los efectos del tiempo atmosférico.

speed-boost.name: speed-boost
speed-boost.descriptionEs: Aumenta su Velocidad en cada turno.
speed-boost.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's Speed stat is boosted every turn.

damp.name: damp
damp.descriptionEs: Aumenta la humedad del entorno y evita que se puedan utilizar movimientos explosivos, tales como Autodestrucción.
damp.descriptionEn: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct.

sand-veil.name: sand-veil
sand-veil.descriptionEs: Aumenta su Evasión durante las tormentas de arena.
sand-veil.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.

battle-armor.name: battle-armor
battle-armor.descriptionEs: La robusta coraza que lo protege bloquea los golpes críticos.
battle-armor.descriptionEn: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

oblivious.name: oblivious
oblivious.descriptionEs: Su indiferencia evita que sea provocado o caiga presa del enamoramiento.
oblivious.descriptionEn: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

static.name: static
static.descriptionEs: La electricidad estática que lo envuelve puede paralizar al mínimo contacto.
static.descriptionEn: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

sturdy.name: sturdy
sturdy.descriptionEs: Evita que el rival pueda debilitarlo de un solo golpe cuando tiene los PS al máximo. También evita los movimientos fulminantes.
sturdy.descriptionEn: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

volt-absorb.name: volt-absorb
volt-absorb.descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Eléctrico, recupera PS en vez de sufrir daño.
volt-absorb.descriptionEn: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

stench.name: stench
stench.descriptionEs: Puede amedrentar al rival al atacarlo debido al mal olor que emana.
stench.descriptionEn: By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.

immunity.name: immunity
immunity.descriptionEs: Su sistema inmunitario evita el envenenamiento.
immunity.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's immune system prevents it from being poisoned.

rough-skin.name: rough-skin
rough-skin.descriptionEs: Hiere con su piel áspera al rival que lo ataque con un movimiento de contacto.
rough-skin.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's rough skin damages attackers that make direct contact with it.

intimidate.name: intimidate
intimidate.descriptionEs: Al entrar en combate amilana al rival de tal manera que su Ataque disminuye.
intimidate.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

levitate.name: levitate
levitate.descriptionEs: Su capacidad de flotar sobre el suelo le proporciona inmunidad frente a los movimientos de tipo Tierra.
levitate.descriptionEn: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

own-tempo.name: own-tempo
own-tempo.descriptionEs: Como le gusta hacer las cosas a su manera, los rivales no logran confundirlo.
own-tempo.descriptionEn: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.

flash-fire.name: flash-fire
flash-fire.descriptionEs: Si le alcanza algún movimiento de tipo Fuego, potencia sus propios movimientos de dicho tipo.
flash-fire.descriptionEn: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.

compound-eyes.name: compound-eyes
compound-eyes.descriptionEs: Aumenta la precisión de sus movimientos.
compound-eyes.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.

serene-grace.name: serene-grace
serene-grace.descriptionEs: Aumenta la probabilidad de que los movimientos causen efectos secundarios.
serene-grace.descriptionEn: Raises the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves.

insomnia.name: insomnia
insomnia.descriptionEs: Su resistencia al sueño le impide quedarse dormido.
insomnia.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's insomnia prevents it from falling asleep.

shadow-tag.name: shadow-tag
shadow-tag.descriptionEs: Impide que el enemigo huya o sea cambiado por otro.
shadow-tag.descriptionEn: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.

wonder-guard.name: wonder-guard
wonder-guard.descriptionEs: Gracias a un poder misterioso, solo le hacen daño los movimientos supereficaces.
wonder-guard.descriptionEn: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.

illuminate.name: illuminate
illuminate.descriptionEs: Aumenta la probabilidad de encontrar Pokémon al iluminar el entorno.
illuminate.descriptionEn: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered.

drizzle.name: drizzle
drizzle.descriptionEs: Hace que llueva al entrar en combate.
drizzle.descriptionEn: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.

color-change.name: color-change
color-change.descriptionEs: Adopta el tipo del último movimiento del que es blanco.
color-change.descriptionEn: The Pokémon’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.

poison-point.name: poison-point
poison-point.descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

water-absorb.name: water-absorb
water-absorb.descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Agua, recupera PS en vez de sufrir daño.
water-absorb.descriptionEn: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

inner-focus.name: inner-focus
inner-focus.descriptionEs: Gracias a su profunda concentración, no se amedrenta ante los ataques del rival.
inner-focus.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

natural-cure.name: natural-cure
natural-cure.descriptionEs: Cura sus problemas de estado al cambiarse con otro Pokémon.
natural-cure.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.

swift-swim.name: swift-swim
swift-swim.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

effect-spore.name: effect-spore
effect-spore.descriptionEs: Puede dormir, envenenar o paralizar al Pokémon con el que entre en contacto al recibir un ataque.
effect-spore.descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on the attacker.

suction-cups.name: suction-cups
suction-cups.descriptionEs: Sus ventosas se aferran al suelo, con lo cual anula movimientos y objetos que fuerzan el relevo.
suction-cups.descriptionEn: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.

clear-body.name: clear-body
clear-body.descriptionEs: Evita que bajen sus características a causa de movimientos o habilidades de otros Pokémon.
clear-body.descriptionEn: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.

magma-armor.name: magma-armor
magma-armor.descriptionEs: Gracias al magma candente que lo envuelve, no puede ser congelado.
magma-armor.descriptionEn: The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.

synchronize.name: synchronize
synchronize.descriptionEs: Contagia el envenenamiento, las quemaduras o la parálisis al Pokémon que le cause ese estado.
synchronize.descriptionEn: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

chlorophyll.name: chlorophyll
chlorophyll.descriptionEs: Sube su Velocidad cuando hace sol.
chlorophyll.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

magnet-pull.name: magnet-pull
magnet-pull.descriptionEs: Su magnetismo atrae a los Pokémon de tipo Acero y les impide huir.
magnet-pull.descriptionEn: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.

shield-dust.name: shield-dust
shield-dust.descriptionEs: El polvo de escamas que lo envuelve lo protege de los efectos secundarios de los ataques recibidos.
shield-dust.descriptionEn: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

run-away.name: run-away
run-away.descriptionEs: Puede escaparse de todos los Pokémon salvajes.
run-away.descriptionEn: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

keen-eye.name: keen-eye
keen-eye.descriptionEs: Su aguda vista evita que le disminuya la Precisión.
keen-eye.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

lightning-rod.name: lightning-rod
lightning-rod.descriptionEs: Atrae y neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico, que además le suben el Ataque Especial.
lightning-rod.descriptionEn: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

hyper-cutter.name: hyper-cutter
hyper-cutter.descriptionEs: Evita que el rival le baje el Ataque.
hyper-cutter.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.

pickup.name: pickup
pickup.descriptionEs: Puede recoger objetos que el rival haya usado, o bien otros que encuentre en plena aventura.
pickup.descriptionEn: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.

trace.name: trace
trace.descriptionEs: Al entrar en combate copia la habilidad del rival.
trace.descriptionEn: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.

hustle.name: hustle
hustle.descriptionEs: Aumenta su Ataque, pero reduce su Precisión.
hustle.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but lowers its accuracy.

cute-charm.name: cute-charm
cute-charm.descriptionEs: Puede causar enamoramiento al rival que lo toque.
cute-charm.descriptionEn: The Pokémon may infatuate attackers that make direct contact with it.

huge-power.name: huge-power
huge-power.descriptionEs: Duplica la potencia de sus ataques físicos.

shed-skin.name: shed-skin
shed-skin.descriptionEs: Puede curar sus problemas de estado al mudar la piel.
shed-skin.descriptionEn: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

water-veil.name: water-veil
water-veil.descriptionEs: Evita las quemaduras gracias a la capa de agua que lo envuelve.
water-veil.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's water veil prevents it from being burned.

sticky-hold.name: sticky-hold
sticky-hold.descriptionEs: Los objetos se quedan pegados a su cuerpo, por lo que no pueden robárselos.
sticky-hold.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

soundproof.name: soundproof
soundproof.descriptionEs: Su aislamiento acústico lo protege de movimientos que usan sonido.
soundproof.descriptionEn: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

guts.name: guts
guts.descriptionEs: Si sufre un problema de estado, se viene arriba y aumenta su Ataque.
guts.descriptionEn: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.

marvel-scale.name: marvel-scale
marvel-scale.descriptionEs: Sube su Defensa si sufre un problema de estado.
marvel-scale.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost its Defense stat if it has a status condition.

overgrow.name: overgrow
overgrow.descriptionEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Planta cuando le quedan pocos PS.
overgrow.descriptionEn: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

sand-stream.name: sand-stream
sand-stream.descriptionEs: Crea una tormenta de arena al entrar en combate.
sand-stream.descriptionEn: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.

thick-fat.name: thick-fat
thick-fat.descriptionEs: Gracias a la gruesa capa de grasa que lo protege, reduce a la mitad el daño que recibe de ataques de tipo Fuego o Hielo.
thick-fat.descriptionEn: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

torrent.name: torrent
torrent.descriptionEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Agua cuando le quedan pocos PS.
torrent.descriptionEn: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

truant.name: truant
truant.descriptionEs: Al ejecutar un movimiento, descansará en el turno siguiente.
truant.descriptionEn: Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.

swarm.name: swarm
swarm.descriptionEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Bicho cuando le quedan pocos PS.
swarm.descriptionEn: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

rock-head.name: rock-head
rock-head.descriptionEs: No puede dañarse con sus propios movimientos.
rock-head.descriptionEn: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

rain-dish.name: rain-dish
rain-dish.descriptionEs: Recupera PS de forma gradual cuando llueve.
rain-dish.descriptionEn: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.

plus.name: plus
plus.descriptionEs: Potencia su Ataque Especial si un Pokémon aliado tiene la habilidad Más o Menos.
plus.descriptionEn: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

early-bird.name: early-bird
early-bird.descriptionEs: Si se duerme, tardará la mitad de tiempo en despertarse.
early-bird.descriptionEn: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

minus.name: minus
minus.descriptionEs: Potencia su Ataque Especial si un Pokémon aliado tiene la habilidad Más o Menos.
minus.descriptionEn: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

drought.name: drought
drought.descriptionEs: Cuando entra en combate, el tiempo pasa a ser soleado.
drought.descriptionEn: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.

rivalry.name: rivalry
rivalry.descriptionEs: Si el objetivo es del mismo sexo, su competitividad le lleva a infligir más daño. Si es del sexo contrario, en cambio, el daño será menor.
rivalry.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's competitive spirit makes it deal more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but less damage to Pokémon of the opposite gender.

shell-armor.name: shell-armor
shell-armor.descriptionEs: La robusta coraza que lo protege bloquea los golpes críticos.
shell-armor.descriptionEn: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

motor-drive.name: motor-drive
motor-drive.descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Eléctrico, le sube la Velocidad en vez de sufrir daño.
motor-drive.descriptionEn: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.

forecast.name: forecast
forecast.descriptionEs: Cambia a tipo Agua, Fuego o Hielo en función del tiempo atmosférico.
forecast.descriptionEn: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.

liquid-ooze.name: liquid-ooze
liquid-ooze.descriptionEs: Exuda una sustancia tóxica de intenso hedor que hiere a quienes intentan drenarle PS.
liquid-ooze.descriptionEn: The strong stench of the Pokémon's oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves.

steadfast.name: steadfast
steadfast.descriptionEs: Cada vez que se amedrenta sube su Velocidad, debido a su voluntad inquebrantable.
steadfast.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's determination boosts its Speed stat every time it flinches.

snow-cloak.name: snow-cloak
snow-cloak.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.

gluttony.name: gluttony
gluttony.descriptionEs: Cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad, engulle la baya que normalmente solo se comería cuando le quedasen pocos PS.
gluttony.descriptionEn: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP is low, it will instead eat the Berry when its HP drops to half or less.

anger-point.name: anger-point
anger-point.descriptionEs: Si recibe un golpe crítico, monta en cólera y sube su Ataque hasta el máximo.
anger-point.descriptionEn: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

pressure.name: pressure
pressure.descriptionEs: Presiona al rival para que sus PP se acaben antes.
pressure.descriptionEn: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

unburden.name: unburden
unburden.descriptionEs: Sube su Velocidad si usa o pierde el objeto que lleva.
unburden.descriptionEn: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.

dry-skin.name: dry-skin
dry-skin.descriptionEs: Pierde PS si hace sol y los recupera si llueve o recibe un movimiento de tipo Agua. Los movimientos de tipo Fuego, por su parte, le hacen más daño de lo normal.
dry-skin.descriptionEn: Restores the Pokémon's HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.

simple.name: simple
simple.descriptionEs: Duplica los cambios en las características.
simple.descriptionEn: Doubles the effects of the Pokémon's stat changes.

iron-fist.name: iron-fist
iron-fist.descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de los puñetazos.

adaptability.name: adaptability
adaptability.descriptionEs: Potencia aún más los movimientos cuyo tipo coincida con el suyo.
adaptability.descriptionEn: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.

hydration.name: hydration
hydration.descriptionEs: Cura los problemas de estado si está lloviendo.
hydration.descriptionEn: Cures the Pokémon's status conditions in rain.

skill-link.name: skill-link
skill-link.descriptionEs: Ejecuta siempre los movimientos múltiples con el número máximo de golpes.
skill-link.descriptionEn: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.

arena-trap.name: arena-trap
arena-trap.descriptionEn: Prevents opposing Pokémon from fleeing from battle.

blaze.name: blaze
blaze.descriptionEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Fuego cuando le quedan pocos PS.
blaze.descriptionEn: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

vital-spirit.name: vital-spirit
vital-spirit.descriptionEs: Su determinación le impide quedarse dormido.
vital-spirit.descriptionEn: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.

sniper.name: sniper
sniper.descriptionEs: Potencia los golpes críticos que asesta aún más de lo normal.
sniper.descriptionEn: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.

download.name: download
download.descriptionEs: Compara la Defensa y la Defensa Especial del rival para ver cuál es inferior y aumenta su propio Ataque o Ataque Especial según sea lo más eficaz.
download.descriptionEn: The Pokémon compares an opposing Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever will be more effective.

pure-power.name: pure-power
pure-power.descriptionEs: Duplica la potencia de sus ataques físicos gracias al yoga.
pure-power.descriptionEn: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

poison-heal.name: poison-heal
poison-heal.descriptionEs: Si resulta envenenado, recupera PS en vez de perderlos.
poison-heal.descriptionEn: If poisoned, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

no-guard.name: no-guard
no-guard.descriptionEs: Al quedar ambos expuestos, tanto sus movimientos como los del rival acertarán siempre.
no-guard.descriptionEn: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.

stall.name: stall
stall.descriptionEs: Ejecuta su movimiento tras todos los demás.
stall.descriptionEn: The Pokémon is always the last to use its moves.

klutz.name: klutz
klutz.descriptionEn: The Pokémon can't use any held items.

air-lock.name: air-lock
air-lock.descriptionEs: Neutraliza todos los efectos del tiempo atmosférico.

tangled-feet.name: tangled-feet
tangled-feet.descriptionEs: Sube su Evasión si está confuso.
tangled-feet.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.

white-smoke.name: white-smoke
white-smoke.descriptionEs: El humo blanco que lo protege evita que otros Pokémon le bajen las características.
white-smoke.descriptionEn: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

super-luck.name: super-luck
super-luck.descriptionEs: Su buena suerte aumenta la probabilidad de asestar golpes críticos.
super-luck.descriptionEn: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.

mold-breaker.name: mold-breaker
mold-breaker.descriptionEs: Las habilidades del objetivo no afectan a los movimientos que emplea.
mold-breaker.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

anticipation.name: anticipation
anticipation.descriptionEs: Prevé los movimientos peligrosos del rival.
anticipation.descriptionEn: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.

heatproof.name: heatproof
heatproof.descriptionEs: Su cuerpo, resistente al calor, reduce a la mitad el daño recibido por movimientos de tipo Fuego.
heatproof.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's heatproof body halves the damage taken from Fire-type moves.

forewarn.name: forewarn
forewarn.descriptionEs: Indica el movimiento más potente del rival al entrar en combate.
forewarn.descriptionEn: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.

unaware.name: unaware
unaware.descriptionEs: Pasa por alto las mejoras en las características del rival al atacar.
unaware.descriptionEn: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.

quick-feet.name: quick-feet
quick-feet.descriptionEs: Aumenta la Velocidad si sufre problemas de estado.
quick-feet.descriptionEn: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.

tinted-lens.name: tinted-lens
tinted-lens.descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos que no son muy eficaces, que infligen ahora un daño normal.
tinted-lens.descriptionEn: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.

scrappy.name: scrappy
scrappy.descriptionEs: Puede alcanzar a Pokémon de tipo Fantasma con movimientos de tipo Normal o Lucha.
scrappy.descriptionEn: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

ice-body.name: ice-body
ice-body.descriptionEs: Recupera PS de forma gradual cuando hay tormentas de granizo.
ice-body.descriptionEn: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.

snow-warning.name: snow-warning
snow-warning.descriptionEs: Invoca una tormenta de granizo al entrar en combate.
snow-warning.descriptionEn: The Pokémon makes it snow when it enters a battle.

normalize.name: normalize
normalize.descriptionEs: Hace que todos sus movimientos se vuelvan de tipo Normal y aumenten ligeramente su potencia.
normalize.descriptionEn: All the Pokémon’s moves become Normal type. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

reckless.name: reckless
reckless.descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos que también dañan al usuario.
reckless.descriptionEn: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.

flower-gift.name: flower-gift
flower-gift.descriptionEs: Si hace sol, aumenta su Ataque y su Defensa Especial, así como los de sus aliados.
flower-gift.descriptionEn: Boosts the Attack and Sp. Def stats of itself and allies in harsh sunlight.

aftermath.name: aftermath
aftermath.descriptionEs: Daña al agresor que le ha dado el golpe de gracia con un movimiento de contacto.
aftermath.descriptionEn: Damages the attacker if it knocks out the Pokémon with a move that makes direct contact.

leaf-guard.name: leaf-guard
leaf-guard.descriptionEs: Evita los problemas de estado si hace sol.
leaf-guard.descriptionEn: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.

technician.name: technician
technician.descriptionEn: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.

pickpocket.name: pickpocket
pickpocket.descriptionEs: Si el rival usa un movimiento de contacto al atacar, le roba el objeto.
pickpocket.descriptionEn: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.

magic-guard.name: magic-guard
magic-guard.descriptionEn: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

sheer-force.name: sheer-force
sheer-force.descriptionEs: Sube la potencia de sus movimientos en detrimento de los efectos secundarios, que se ven anulados.
sheer-force.descriptionEn: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.

unnerve.name: unnerve
unnerve.descriptionEs: Pone nervioso al rival y le impide usar bayas.
unnerve.descriptionEn: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

defiant.name: defiant
defiant.descriptionEs: Sube mucho su Ataque cuando el rival le baja las características.
defiant.descriptionEn: If the Pokémon has any stat lowered by an opposing Pokémon, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply.

frisk.name: frisk
frisk.descriptionEs: Puede ver el objeto que lleva el rival al entrar en combate.
frisk.descriptionEn: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.

slow-start.name: slow-start
slow-start.descriptionEs: Baja a la mitad su Ataque y su Velocidad durante cinco turnos.
slow-start.descriptionEn: For five turns, the Pokémon's Attack and Speed stats are halved.

filter.name: filter
filter.descriptionEs: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
filter.descriptionEn: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

honey-gather.name: honey-gather
honey-gather.descriptionEs: Puede que encuentre Miel una vez concluido el combate.
honey-gather.descriptionEn: The Pokémon may gather Honey after a battle.

cursed-body.name: cursed-body
cursed-body.descriptionEs: Puede anular el movimiento usado en su contra.
cursed-body.descriptionEn: May disable a move that has dealt damage to the Pokémon.

friend-guard.name: friend-guard
friend-guard.descriptionEs: Reduce el daño que sufren los aliados.

storm-drain.name: storm-drain
storm-drain.descriptionEs: Atrae y neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Agua, que además le suben el Ataque Especial.
storm-drain.descriptionEn: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

multiscale.name: multiscale
multiscale.descriptionEs: Reduce el daño que sufre si sus PS están al máximo.
multiscale.descriptionEn: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

telepathy.name: telepathy
telepathy.descriptionEs: Elude los ataques de los aliados durante el combate.
telepathy.descriptionEn: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

bad-dreams.name: bad-dreams
bad-dreams.descriptionEs: Inflige daño a cualquier rival que esté dormido.
bad-dreams.descriptionEn: Damages opposing Pokémon that are asleep.

contrary.name: contrary
contrary.descriptionEs: Invierte los cambios en las características: bajan cuando les toca subir y suben cuando les toca bajar.
contrary.descriptionEn: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Pokémon so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them—and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.

solar-power.name: solar-power
solar-power.descriptionEs: Si hace sol, aumenta su Ataque Especial, pero pierde PS en cada turno.
solar-power.descriptionEn: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.

multitype.name: multitype
multitype.descriptionEs: Cambia su tipo al de la tabla o al del Cristal Z que lleve.
multitype.descriptionEn: Changes the Pokémon's type to match the plate it holds.

overcoat.name: overcoat
overcoat.descriptionEs: No le afectan las tormentas de arena, el granizo y los movimientos con polvos.
overcoat.descriptionEn: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.

healer.name: healer
healer.descriptionEs: A veces cura los problemas de estado de un aliado.
healer.descriptionEn: Sometimes cures the status conditions of the Pokémon's allies.

defeatist.name: defeatist
defeatist.descriptionEs: Se debilita tanto cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad que su Ataque y su Ataque Especial bajan.
defeatist.descriptionEn: Halves the Pokémon’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats when its HP becomes half or less.

regenerator.name: regenerator
regenerator.descriptionEs: Recupera unos pocos PS al ser cambiado por otro Pokémon.
regenerator.descriptionEn: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.

solid-rock.name: solid-rock
solid-rock.descriptionEs: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
solid-rock.descriptionEn: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

weak-armor.name: weak-armor
weak-armor.descriptionEs: Al recibir daño de un ataque físico, le baja la Defensa, pero le sube mucho la Velocidad.
weak-armor.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.

light-metal.name: light-metal
light-metal.descriptionEs: Reduce a la mitad su peso.

toxic-boost.name: toxic-boost
toxic-boost.descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de sus ataques físicos cuando está envenenado.
toxic-boost.descriptionEn: Powers up physical moves when the Pokémon is poisoned.

infiltrator.name: infiltrator
infiltrator.descriptionEs: Ataca sorteando la barrera o el sustituto del rival.
infiltrator.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and the like.

moxie.name: moxie
moxie.descriptionEs: Al debilitar a un objetivo, su confianza se refuerza de tal manera que aumenta su Ataque.
moxie.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.

imposter.name: imposter
imposter.descriptionEs: Se transforma en el Pokémon que tiene enfrente.
imposter.descriptionEn: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.

harvest.name: harvest
harvest.descriptionEs: Puede reutilizar varias veces una misma baya.
harvest.descriptionEn: May create another Berry after one is used.

rattled.name: rattled
rattled.descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Siniestro, Bicho o Fantasma, el miedo hace que le suba la Velocidad.
rattled.descriptionEn: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.

moody.name: moody
moody.descriptionEs: Una característica le sube mucho en cada turno, pero le baja otra.
moody.descriptionEn: Every turn, one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted sharply but another stat will be lowered.

poison-touch.name: poison-touch
poison-touch.descriptionEs: Puede envenenar al objetivo con solo tocarlo.
poison-touch.descriptionEn: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.

magic-bounce.name: magic-bounce
magic-bounce.descriptionEs: Puede devolver los movimientos de estado lanzados por el rival, sin verse afectado por ellos.
magic-bounce.descriptionEn: The Pokémon reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.

flare-boost.name: flare-boost
flare-boost.descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de sus ataques especiales cuando sufre quemaduras.
flare-boost.descriptionEn: Powers up special moves when the Pokémon is burned.

analytic.name: analytic
analytic.descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de su movimiento si es el último en atacar.
analytic.descriptionEn: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.

iron-barbs.name: iron-barbs
iron-barbs.descriptionEs: Inflige daño al rival si este le golpea con un movimiento de contacto.
iron-barbs.descriptionEn: Inflicts damage on the attacker upon contact with iron barbs.

sand-force.name: sand-force
sand-force.descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Tierra, Acero y Roca durante las tormentas de arena.
sand-force.descriptionEn: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.

sand-rush.name: sand-rush
sand-rush.descriptionEs: Aumenta su Velocidad durante las tormentas de arena.
sand-rush.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.

victory-star.name: victory-star
victory-star.descriptionEs: Sube su Precisión y la de sus aliados.
victory-star.descriptionEn: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.

flame-body.name: flame-body
flame-body.descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

prankster.name: prankster
prankster.descriptionEs: Sus movimientos de estado tienen prioridad alta.
prankster.descriptionEn: Gives priority to the Pokémon's status moves.

justified.name: justified
justified.descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Siniestro, aumenta el Ataque debido a su integridad.
justified.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

sap-sipper.name: sap-sipper
sap-sipper.descriptionEs: Neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Planta y sube su Ataque.
sap-sipper.descriptionEn: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.

mummy.name: mummy
mummy.descriptionEs: Contagia la habilidad Momia al rival que entre en contacto con él.
mummy.descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Mummy.

illusion.name: illusion
illusion.descriptionEs: Adopta el aspecto del último Pokémon del equipo al entrar en combate para desconcertar al rival.
illusion.descriptionEn: The Pokémon fools opponents by entering battle disguised as the last Pokémon in its Trainer's party.

zen-mode.name: zen-mode
zen-mode.descriptionEs: Cambia de forma si sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad.
zen-mode.descriptionEn: Changes the Pokémon’s shape when HP is half or less.

protean.name: protean
protean.descriptionEs: Cambia su tipo al del movimiento que va a usar.
protean.descriptionEn: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

flower-veil.name: flower-veil
flower-veil.descriptionEs: Evita que los Pokémon de tipo Planta aliados sufran problemas de estado o que les bajen sus características.
flower-veil.descriptionEn: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.

magician.name: magician
magician.descriptionEs: Roba el objeto del Pokémon al que alcance con un movimiento.
magician.descriptionEn: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.

bulletproof.name: bulletproof
bulletproof.descriptionEs: No le afectan las bombas ni algunos proyectiles.
bulletproof.descriptionEn: Protects the Pokémon from ball and bomb moves.

competitive.name: competitive
competitive.descriptionEs: Aumenta mucho su Ataque Especial cuando el rival le baja cualquiera de sus características.
competitive.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.

turboblaze.name: turboblaze
turboblaze.descriptionEs: Las habilidades del objetivo no afectan a los movimientos que emplea.
turboblaze.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

teravolt.name: teravolt
teravolt.descriptionEs: Las habilidades del objetivo no afectan a los movimientos que emplea.
teravolt.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

strong-jaw.name: strong-jaw
strong-jaw.descriptionEs: Su robusta mandíbula le confiere una mordedura potente.
strong-jaw.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.

cheek-pouch.name: cheek-pouch
cheek-pouch.descriptionEs: Recupera PS al comer cualquier baya.
cheek-pouch.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's HP is restored when it eats any Berry, in addition to the Berry's usual effect.

stance-change.name: stance-change
stance-change.descriptionEs: Adopta la Forma Filo al lanzar un ataque, o bien la Forma Escudo si usa el movimiento Escudo Real.
stance-change.descriptionEn: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.

sweet-veil.name: sweet-veil
sweet-veil.descriptionEs: No cae dormido y evita también que sus aliados se duerman.
sweet-veil.descriptionEn: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.

tough-claws.name: tough-claws
tough-claws.descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de los movimientos de contacto.
tough-claws.descriptionEn: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

gooey.name: gooey
gooey.descriptionEs: Baja la Velocidad del rival cuando este le ataca con un movimiento de contacto.
gooey.descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

fur-coat.name: fur-coat
fur-coat.descriptionEs: Reduce a la mitad el daño que recibe de ataques físicos del rival.
fur-coat.descriptionEn: Halves the damage from physical moves.

wonder-skin.name: wonder-skin
wonder-skin.descriptionEs: Presenta una mayor resistencia ante los movimientos de estado.
wonder-skin.descriptionEn: Makes status moves more likely to miss the Pokémon.

pixilate.name: pixilate
pixilate.descriptionEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Hada y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
pixilate.descriptionEn: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

aroma-veil.name: aroma-veil
aroma-veil.descriptionEs: Se protege a sí mismo y a sus aliados de ataques que impiden elegir movimientos.
aroma-veil.descriptionEn: Protects the Pokémon and its allies from effects that prevent the use of moves.

gale-wings.name: gale-wings
gale-wings.descriptionEs: Da prioridad a los movimientos de tipo Volador si sus PS están al máximo.
gale-wings.descriptionEn: Gives priority to the Pokémon's Flying-type moves while its HP is full.

parental-bond.name: parental-bond
parental-bond.descriptionEs: Une fuerzas con su cría y ataca dos veces.

mega-launcher.name: mega-launcher
mega-launcher.descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de algunos movimientos de pulsos y auras.

symbiosis.name: symbiosis
symbiosis.descriptionEs: Pasa su objeto a un aliado que ya haya utilizado el suyo.
symbiosis.descriptionEn: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.

refrigerate.name: refrigerate
refrigerate.descriptionEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Hielo y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
refrigerate.descriptionEn: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

emergency-exit.name: emergency-exit
emergency-exit.descriptionEs: Abandona el terreno de combate cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad para evitar males mayores.
emergency-exit.descriptionEn: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

stakeout.name: stakeout
stakeout.descriptionEs: Si el objetivo de su ataque es sustituido por otro, duplica el daño que infligirá.
stakeout.descriptionEn: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.

shields-down.name: shields-down
shields-down.descriptionEs: Rompe su coraza cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad y adopta una forma ofensiva.
shields-down.descriptionEn: When its HP drops to half or less, the Pokémon's shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.

fairy-aura.name: fairy-aura
fairy-aura.descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de todos los movimientos de tipo Hada.
fairy-aura.descriptionEn: Powers up each Pokémon’s Fairy-type moves.

aerilate.name: aerilate
aerilate.descriptionEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Volador y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
aerilate.descriptionEn: Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

big-pecks.name: big-pecks
big-pecks.descriptionEs: Impide que el rival le baje la Defensa.
big-pecks.descriptionEn: Prevents the Pokémon from having its Defense stat lowered.

aura-break.name: aura-break
aura-break.descriptionEs: Invierte los efectos de las auras, por lo que baja la potencia de ciertos movimientos en vez de subirla.
aura-break.descriptionEn: The effects of “Aura” Abilities are reversed to lower the power of affected moves.

steelworker.name: steelworker
steelworker.descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero.

long-reach.name: long-reach
long-reach.descriptionEs: Puede usar cualquier movimiento sin entrar en contacto con el rival.
long-reach.descriptionEn: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.

dark-aura.name: dark-aura
dark-aura.descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de todos los movimientos de tipo Siniestro.
dark-aura.descriptionEn: Powers up each Pokémon’s Dark-type moves.

delta-stream.name: delta-stream
delta-stream.descriptionEs: Altera el clima para anular las vulnerabilidades del tipo Volador.
delta-stream.descriptionEn: The Pokémon changes the weather to eliminate all of the Flying type’s weaknesses.

grass-pelt.name: grass-pelt
grass-pelt.descriptionEs: Aumenta su Defensa si hay un campo de hierba en el terreno de combate.
grass-pelt.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat on Grassy Terrain.

primordial-sea.name: primordial-sea
primordial-sea.descriptionEs: Altera el clima para anular los ataques de tipo Fuego.
primordial-sea.descriptionEn: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.

desolate-land.name: desolate-land
desolate-land.descriptionEs: Altera el clima para anular los ataques de tipo Agua.
desolate-land.descriptionEn: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks.

liquid-voice.name: liquid-voice
liquid-voice.descriptionEs: Hace que todos sus movimientos que usan sonido pasen a ser de tipo Agua.

galvanize.name: galvanize
galvanize.descriptionEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Eléctrico y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
galvanize.descriptionEn: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

power-construct.name: power-construct
power-construct.descriptionEs: Cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad, las células se reagrupan y adopta su Forma Completa.
power-construct.descriptionEn: Other Cells gather to aid when its HP becomes half or less. Then the Pokémon changes its form to Complete Forme.

stamina.name: stamina
stamina.descriptionEs: Aumenta su Defensa al recibir un ataque.
stamina.descriptionEn: Boosts the Defense stat when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

disguise.name: disguise
disguise.descriptionEs: Puede eludir un ataque valiéndose de la tela que le cubre el cuerpo una vez por combate.
disguise.descriptionEn: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.

battle-bond.name: battle-bond
battle-bond.descriptionEs: Al derrotar a un rival, los vínculos con su Entrenador se refuerzan y se convierte en Greninja Ash. Su Shuriken de Agua también se ve potenciado.
battle-bond.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, its bond with its Trainer is strengthened, and its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats are boosted.

wimp-out.name: wimp-out
wimp-out.descriptionEs: Se asusta y abandona el terreno de combate cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad.
wimp-out.descriptionEn: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

water-bubble.name: water-bubble
water-bubble.descriptionEs: Reduce el daño que le provocan los movimientos de tipo Fuego y es inmune a las quemaduras.
water-bubble.descriptionEn: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.

merciless.name: merciless
merciless.descriptionEs: Hace que sus movimientos asesten siempre un golpe crítico si el rival está envenenado.
merciless.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

slush-rush.name: slush-rush
slush-rush.descriptionEs: Aumenta su Velocidad si está granizando.
slush-rush.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.

dancer.name: dancer
dancer.descriptionEs: Puede copiar inmediatamente cualquier movimiento de baile que haya usado otro Pokémon presente en el combate.
dancer.descriptionEn: Whenever a dance move is used in battle, the Pokémon will copy the user to immediately perform that dance move itself.

fluffy.name: fluffy
fluffy.descriptionEs: Reduce a la mitad el daño provocado por los movimientos de contacto, pero duplica el infligido por los de tipo Fuego.
fluffy.descriptionEn: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

water-compaction.name: water-compaction
water-compaction.descriptionEs: Aumenta mucho su Defensa si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Agua.
water-compaction.descriptionEn: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Pokémon is hit by a Water-type move.

surge-surfer.name: surge-surfer
surge-surfer.descriptionEs: Duplica su Velocidad si hay un campo eléctrico en el terreno de combate.
surge-surfer.descriptionEn: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

berserk.name: berserk
berserk.descriptionEs: Aumenta su Ataque Especial si sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad debido a algún ataque.
berserk.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to drop to half or less.

triage.name: triage
triage.descriptionEs: Da prioridad a los movimientos que restauran PS.
triage.descriptionEn: Gives priority to the Pokémon's healing moves.

electric-surge.name: electric-surge
electric-surge.descriptionEs: Crea un campo eléctrico al entrar en combate.
electric-surge.descriptionEn: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

schooling.name: schooling
schooling.descriptionEs: Forma bancos con sus congéneres cuando tiene muchos PS, lo cual le otorga más fuerza. Cuando le quedan pocos PS, el banco se dispersa.
schooling.descriptionEn: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.

comatose.name: comatose
comatose.descriptionEs: No despierta jamás de su profundo letargo e incluso ataca dormido.
comatose.descriptionEn: The Pokémon is always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack while in its sleeping state.

queenly-majesty.name: queenly-majesty
queenly-majesty.descriptionEs: Intimida al objetivo y le impide usar movimientos con prioridad.
queenly-majesty.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

grassy-surge.name: grassy-surge
grassy-surge.descriptionEs: Crea un campo de hierba al entrar en combate.
grassy-surge.descriptionEn: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

corrosion.name: corrosion
corrosion.descriptionEs: Puede envenenar incluso a rivales de tipo Acero o Veneno.
corrosion.descriptionEn: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.

innards-out.name: innards-out
innards-out.descriptionEs: Al caer debilitado, inflige al rival un daño equivalente a los PS que le quedaran.
innards-out.descriptionEn: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.

rks-system.name: rks-system
rks-system.descriptionEs: Cambia su tipo según el disco que lleve instalado.
rks-system.descriptionEn: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the memory disc it holds.

dazzling.name: dazzling
dazzling.descriptionEs: Desconcierta al rival y le impide utilizar movimientos con prioridad en su contra.
dazzling.descriptionEn: The Pokémon dazzles its opponents, making them unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

psychic-surge.name: psychic-surge
psychic-surge.descriptionEs: Crea un campo psíquico al entrar en combate.
psychic-surge.descriptionEn: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

soul-heart.name: soul-heart
soul-heart.descriptionEs: Aumenta su Ataque Especial cada vez que un Pokémon cae debilitado.
soul-heart.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat every time another Pokémon faints.

battery.name: battery
battery.descriptionEs: Potencia los ataques especiales de los aliados.
battery.descriptionEn: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.

full-metal-body.name: full-metal-body
full-metal-body.descriptionEs: Evita que bajen sus características a causa de movimientos o habilidades de otros Pokémon.
full-metal-body.descriptionEn: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.

ball-fetch.name: ball-fetch
ball-fetch.descriptionEs: Si no lleva equipado ningún objeto, recupera la Poké Ball del primer intento de captura fallido.
ball-fetch.descriptionEn: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.

libero.name: libero
libero.descriptionEs: Cambia su tipo al del movimiento que va a usar.
libero.descriptionEn: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

shadow-shield.name: shadow-shield
shadow-shield.descriptionEs: Reduce el daño que sufre si sus PS están al máximo.
shadow-shield.descriptionEn: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

misty-surge.name: misty-surge
misty-surge.descriptionEs: Crea un campo de niebla al entrar en combate.
misty-surge.descriptionEn: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

receiver.name: receiver
receiver.descriptionEs: Adquiere la habilidad de un aliado debilitado.
receiver.descriptionEn: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

intrepid-sword.name: intrepid-sword
intrepid-sword.descriptionEs: Aumenta su Ataque al entrar en combate.
intrepid-sword.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

beast-boost.name: beast-boost
beast-boost.descriptionEs: Si derrota a un rival en ese turno, aumenta su característica más fuerte.
beast-boost.descriptionEn: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.

neuroforce.name: neuroforce
neuroforce.descriptionEn: Powers up moves that are super effective.

stalwart.name: stalwart
stalwart.descriptionEs: Impide que el rival pueda atraer ataques hacia sí mismo por efecto de su habilidad o sus movimientos.
stalwart.descriptionEn: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

prism-armor.name: prism-armor
prism-armor.descriptionEs: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
prism-armor.descriptionEn: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

tangling-hair.name: tangling-hair
tangling-hair.descriptionEs: Baja la Velocidad del rival cuando este le ataca con un movimiento de contacto.
tangling-hair.descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

ice-face.name: ice-face
ice-face.descriptionEs: Absorbe el daño de un ataque físico con el hielo de la cabeza, tras lo cual cambia de forma. El hielo se regenerará la próxima vez que granice.
ice-face.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon's appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.

cotton-down.name: cotton-down
cotton-down.descriptionEs: Al ser alcanzado por un ataque, suelta una pelusa de algodón que reduce la Velocidad de todos los demás Pokémon.
cotton-down.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.

propeller-tail.name: propeller-tail
propeller-tail.descriptionEs: Impide que el rival pueda atraer ataques hacia sí mismo por efecto de su habilidad o sus movimientos.
propeller-tail.descriptionEn: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

mirror-armor.name: mirror-armor
mirror-armor.descriptionEs: Refleja los efectos que reducen las características.
mirror-armor.descriptionEn: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

gulp-missile.name: gulp-missile
gulp-missile.descriptionEs: Tras usar Surf o Buceo, emerge con una presa en la boca. Al recibir daño, ataca escupiéndola al rival.
gulp-missile.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

dauntless-shield.name: dauntless-shield
dauntless-shield.descriptionEs: Aumenta su Defensa al entrar en combate.
dauntless-shield.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

wandering-spirit.name: wandering-spirit
wandering-spirit.descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de contacto, intercambia su habilidad con la del agresor.
wandering-spirit.descriptionEn: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

steam-engine.name: steam-engine
steam-engine.descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Fuego o Agua, le sube muchísimo la Velocidad.
steam-engine.descriptionEn: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

ice-scales.name: ice-scales
ice-scales.descriptionEs: Las gélidas escamas que protegen su cuerpo reducen a la mitad el daño que le infligen los ataques especiales.
ice-scales.descriptionEn: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

sand-spit.name: sand-spit
sand-spit.descriptionEs: Provoca una tormenta de arena al recibir un ataque.
sand-spit.descriptionEn: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.

screen-cleaner.name: screen-cleaner
screen-cleaner.descriptionEs: Anula los efectos de Pantalla de Luz, Reflejo y Velo Aurora tanto de rivales como de aliados al entrar en combate.
screen-cleaner.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

power-spot.name: power-spot
power-spot.descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de los Pokémon adyacentes.
power-spot.descriptionEn: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

mimicry.name: mimicry
mimicry.descriptionEs: Cambia su tipo según el campo que haya en el terreno de combate.
mimicry.descriptionEn: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.

ripen.name: ripen
ripen.descriptionEs: Hace madurar las bayas, por lo que duplica sus efectos.
ripen.descriptionEn: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

unseen-fist.name: unseen-fist
unseen-fist.descriptionEs: Si usa un movimiento de contacto, puede infligir daño al objetivo aunque este se proteja.
unseen-fist.descriptionEn: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

power-of-alchemy.name: power-of-alchemy
power-of-alchemy.descriptionEs: Reacciona copiando la habilidad de un aliado debilitado.
power-of-alchemy.descriptionEn: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

perish-body.name: perish-body
perish-body.descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de contacto, se debilitará al cabo de 3 turnos, así como su agresor, a menos que abandonen el terreno de combate.
perish-body.descriptionEn: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.

neutralizing-gas.name: neutralizing-gas
neutralizing-gas.descriptionEs: Anula los efectos de las habilidades de los demás Pokémon presentes mientras esté en el terreno de combate.
neutralizing-gas.descriptionEn: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

pastel-veil.name: pastel-veil
pastel-veil.descriptionEs: Se protege a sí mismo y a sus aliados del envenenamiento.
pastel-veil.descriptionEn: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.

steely-spirit.name: steely-spirit
steely-spirit.descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero de los aliados.
steely-spirit.descriptionEn: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.

gorilla-tactics.name: gorilla-tactics
gorilla-tactics.descriptionEs: Potencia su Ataque, pero solo puede usar el primer movimiento escogido.
gorilla-tactics.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.

anger-shell.name: anger-shell
anger-shell.descriptionEs: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
anger-shell.descriptionEn: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

curious-medicine.name: curious-medicine
curious-medicine.descriptionEs: Al entrar en combate, rezuma una substancia medicinal por la caracola que revierte los cambios en las características de los aliados.
curious-medicine.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

transistor.name: transistor
transistor.descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico.

dragons-maw.name: dragons-maw
dragons-maw.descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Dragón.

hunger-switch.name: hunger-switch
hunger-switch.descriptionEs: Alterna entre su Forma Saciada y Forma Voraz al final de cada turno.
hunger-switch.descriptionEn: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.

quick-draw.name: quick-draw
quick-draw.descriptionEs: A veces, puede atacar el primero.
quick-draw.descriptionEn: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

chilling-neigh.name: chilling-neigh
chilling-neigh.descriptionEs: Al derrotar a un objetivo, emite un relincho gélido y aumenta su Ataque.
chilling-neigh.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

as-one-spectrier.name: as-one-spectrier
as-one-spectrier.descriptionEs: El Pokémon tiene dos habilidades: Relincho Negro de Spectrier y Nerviosismo de Calyrex.
as-one-spectrier.descriptionEn: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Spectrier's Grim Neigh Ability.

lingering-aroma.name: lingering-aroma
lingering-aroma.descriptionEs: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.
lingering-aroma.descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

grim-neigh.name: grim-neigh
grim-neigh.descriptionEs: Al derrotar a un objetivo, emite un relincho aterrador y aumenta su Ataque Especial.
grim-neigh.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

seed-sower.name: seed-sower
seed-sower.descriptionEs: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
seed-sower.descriptionEn: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

purifying-salt.name: purifying-salt
purifying-salt.descriptionEs: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
purifying-salt.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

commander.name: commander
commander.descriptionEs: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.
commander.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

quark-drive.name: quark-drive
quark-drive.descriptionEs: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
quark-drive.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

well-baked-body.name: well-baked-body
well-baked-body.descriptionEs: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.
well-baked-body.descriptionEn: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

wind-power.name: wind-power
wind-power.descriptionEs: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
wind-power.descriptionEn: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

wind-rider.name: wind-rider
wind-rider.descriptionEs: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
wind-rider.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

punk-rock.name: punk-rock
punk-rock.descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos que usan sonido y reduce a la mitad el daño que le infligen dichos movimientos.
punk-rock.descriptionEn: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

zero-to-hero.name: zero-to-hero
zero-to-hero.descriptionEs: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
zero-to-hero.descriptionEn: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.

hadron-engine.name: hadron-engine
hadron-engine.descriptionEs: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.
hadron-engine.descriptionEn: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

cud-chew.name: cud-chew
cud-chew.descriptionEs: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.
cud-chew.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

orichalcum-pulse.name: orichalcum-pulse
orichalcum-pulse.descriptionEs: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.
orichalcum-pulse.descriptionEn: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

sword-of-ruin.name: sword-of-ruin
sword-of-ruin.descriptionEs: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.
sword-of-ruin.descriptionEn: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

beads-of-ruin.name: beads-of-ruin
beads-of-ruin.descriptionEs: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.
beads-of-ruin.descriptionEn: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

good-as-gold.name: good-as-gold
good-as-gold.descriptionEs: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.
good-as-gold.descriptionEn: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.

protosynthesis.name: protosynthesis
protosynthesis.descriptionEs: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
protosynthesis.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

as-one-glastrier.name: as-one-glastrier
as-one-glastrier.descriptionEs: El Pokémon tiene dos habilidades: Relincho Blanco de Glastrier y Nerviosismo de Calyrex.
as-one-glastrier.descriptionEn: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Glastrier's Chilling Neigh Ability.

armor-tail.name: armor-tail
armor-tail.descriptionEs: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
armor-tail.descriptionEn: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

opportunist.name: opportunist
opportunist.descriptionEs: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
opportunist.descriptionEn: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

supersweet-syrup.name: supersweet-syrup
supersweet-syrup.descriptionEs: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle
supersweet-syrup.descriptionEn: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

costar.name: costar
costar.descriptionEs: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.
costar.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.

toxic-debris.name: toxic-debris
toxic-debris.descriptionEs: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
toxic-debris.descriptionEn: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

mycelium-might.name: mycelium-might
mycelium-might.descriptionEs: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
mycelium-might.descriptionEn: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

earth-eater.name: earth-eater
earth-eater.descriptionEs: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
earth-eater.descriptionEn: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

hospitality.name: hospitality
hospitality.descriptionEs: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP
hospitality.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP

electromorphosis.name: electromorphosis
electromorphosis.descriptionEs: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
electromorphosis.descriptionEn: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

thermal-exchange.name: thermal-exchange
thermal-exchange.descriptionEs: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
thermal-exchange.descriptionEn: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

dragonize.name: dragonize
dragonize.descriptionEs: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
dragonize.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

poison-puppeteer.name: poison-puppeteer
poison-puppeteer.descriptionEs: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
poison-puppeteer.descriptionEn: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

guard-dog.name: guard-dog
guard-dog.descriptionEs: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.
guard-dog.descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

toxic-chain.name: toxic-chain
toxic-chain.descriptionEs: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move
toxic-chain.descriptionEn: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move

embody-aspect.name: embody-aspect
embody-aspect.descriptionEs: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Mask to shine and one of the Pokémon's stats to be boosted.
embody-aspect.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Mask to shine and one of the Pokémon's stats to be boosted.

tera-shift.name: tera-shift
tera-shift.descriptionEs: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
tera-shift.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

minds-eye.name: minds-eye
minds-eye.descriptionEs: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves
minds-eye.descriptionEn: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves

aura-guard.name: aura-guard
aura-guard.descriptionEs: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact. Moves affected by Long Reach which make contact will deal regular damage.
aura-guard.descriptionEn: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact. Moves affected by Long Reach which make contact will deal regular damage.

mega-sol.name: mega-sol
mega-sol.descriptionEs: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
mega-sol.descriptionEn: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

vessel-of-ruin.name: vessel-of-ruin
vessel-of-ruin.descriptionEs: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.
vessel-of-ruin.descriptionEn: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

teraform-zero.name: teraform-zero
teraform-zero.descriptionEs: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.
teraform-zero.descriptionEn: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.

tablets-of-ruin.name: tablets-of-ruin
tablets-of-ruin.descriptionEs: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
tablets-of-ruin.descriptionEn: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

tera-shell.name: tera-shell
tera-shell.descriptionEs: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
tera-shell.descriptionEn: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

eelevate.name: eelevate
eelevate.descriptionEs: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.
eelevate.descriptionEn: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

supreme-overlord.name: supreme-overlord
supreme-overlord.descriptionEs: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
supreme-overlord.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

spicy-spray.name: spicy-spray
spicy-spray.descriptionEs: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
spicy-spray.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

piercing-drill.name: piercing-drill
piercing-drill.descriptionEs: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
piercing-drill.descriptionEn: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.

fire-mane.name: fire-mane
fire-mane.descriptionEs: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.
fire-mane.descriptionEn: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.
